def test_config_command(app, runner):
    app.config["SECRET_KEY"] = "super-secret"
    app.config["PASSWORD"] = "secret-pass"
    app.config["SOME_TOKEN"] = "token-val"
    app.config["API_KEY"] = "key-val"
    app.config["DEBUG"] = False

    result = runner.invoke(app.test_cli_runner(), ["config"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    import json
    data = json.loads(result.output)
    assert data["SECRET_KEY"] == "***"
    assert data["PASSWORD"] == "***"
    assert data["SOME_TOKEN"] == "***"
    assert data["API_KEY"] == "***"
    assert data["DEBUG"] is False
"}]}
